short_summary: Patent filing receipt for HealthRate Inc's invention related to health system pricing index.
long_summary: HealthRate Inc filed a provisional patent application for the HealthRate Institution Index, a method to determine Provider Price Index across US health systems. Application #63/707,441 was filed on October 15, 2024, with inventors Tim Michaels and Jeff Sage, and correspondence address in Carson City, NV.
